Our Experts

Meet The Specialists

Dr. Rahul Kale

Implantologist & Gum Surgeon

"Restoring the Foundation of Your Smile."

Dr. Rahul Kale is a distinguished Implantologist and Gum Surgeon dedicated to the structural integrity of oral health. He specializes in Periodontics, helping patients combat gum disease and restoring lost teeth with precision dental implants.

MDS in Periodontology and Oral Implantology
Dental ImplantsGum SurgeryBone Grafting

Dr. Nilesh Mote

Orthodontist

"Crafting Confident Smiles Through Precision Alignment."

Dr. Nilesh Mote is the architect behind perfectly aligned smiles. Whether treating teenagers or adults, he utilizes modern orthodontic techniques to correct misalignments and bite issues, ensuring functional harmony.

MDS in Orthodontics
Smile CorrectionModern BracesClear Aligners

Dr. Pratik Raut

Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

"Advanced Surgical Care for Complex Oral Needs."

Dr. Pratik Raut is an esteemed Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon known for handling complex surgical procedures. From difficult wisdom tooth extractions to corrective jaw surgeries, he provides high-level care for challenging cases.

MDS in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
Surgical ExtractionsMaxillofacial TraumaPathology Management
